justifications.civic-impact: The project directly answers questions Oak Park residents visibly debate — school quality comparisons and tax burden justification — and names specific audiences (parents, taxpayers, school boards) with concrete takeaways they couldn't easily get before.
justifications.data-integrity: Sources are explicitly named (ISBE Illinois Report Card datasets 2018–2025, Cook County Clerk tax rate reports) with specific files and methods, and the team proactively states data limitations such as test changes, missing 2020 tests, lagging spending figures, and a verified three-year lag in tax reporting.
justifications.data-provenance: The submission names a concrete script and a clear sequence of steps (filter, column-mapping via data/column-mapping.json, join by state ID, derive tax-per-student, trim) from named source files to named outputs (districts.json, schools.json, levies.json), making most of the pipeline traceable and rerunnable; the tax cross-check (5.14 vs 5.135) is even explicitly verified.
justifications.usability-access: The dashboard explicitly leads with 'plain-language findings' and 'the bottom line,' and gives concrete, everyday-language takeaways (e.g., tax rate ranked 3rd of 11 towns, OPRF top 3 in Cook County) that a resident could grasp at a glance.
justifications.craft: The write-up describes a fully fleshed-out, multi-section dashboard (findings cards, Taxes & value, Trends, Cook County scatter, Schools, Priorities, Map) with specific, verifiable-sounding numbers (e.g. '$8.37 per $100... 3rd highest of 11 nearby towns', 'D97's 5.14 in the 2025 report card matches the Clerk's 5.135 for tax year 2022') that suggest the data pipeline actually ran end-to-end and handled the stated traps (2025 test change, missing 2020 tests, one-year spending lag); a live demo URL is also provided as the finished artifact.; the main rough edge is that no repository or artifacts were included ('Repository: (not provided)', 'Artifacts: (none)'), so the only evidence of craft is the team's own detailed narrative rather than an independently inspectable file or screenshot.
justifications.continuation: The submission description is detailed about methodology (column mapping, joins, derived fields, data traps handled) and references specific files like scripts/build_report_card_data.py and data/column-mapping.json, which would help a knowledgeable staffer, but no actual repository link is provided and no README was included to verify these artifacts exist or are organized for handoff.
